text:
Sam: quick note — while testing the refreshed quickstart I hit a token mismatch: the Go example expects REDWOOD_API_KEY but the bash snippet in quickstart/hello.md sets REDWOOD_TOKEN.
Priya: ouch. where did that come from?
Sam: looks like two authors used different names during the SDK snippet migration. affects the docker and serverless quickstarts too.
Leo: can we standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY and update all snippets in one pass? also add a tiny smoke in docs CI so we catch regressions.
Priya: agreed. plan: 1) update quickstart snippets (bash, go, ts, py, dockerfile) to REDWOOD_API_KEY 2) add examples/ci/auth_check.sh that calls /v1/whoami 3) add a docs-ci job step to run that script for examples.
Sam: sample smoke script: ```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${REDWOOD_API_KEY:-}" ]; then
  echo "REDWOOD_API_KEY not set"; exit 2
fi
HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${REDWOOD_API_KEY}" "${REDWOOD_BASE_URL:-https://api.redwood.ai}/v1/whoami" || true)
if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "200" ]; then
  echo "whoami returned $HTTP_STATUS"; exit 1
fi
echo "auth ok"
```
Leo: nice. when you open the PR, include a grep report of all matches so we can review where old names exist. something like `git grep -n "REDWOOD_TOKEN\|REDWOOD_API_KEY" docs | sort` and attach output.
Priya: will do. also adding a short troubleshooting blurb: "If you get 401s, verify your env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and that token starts with `sk-`."
Sam: don't forget to update the CODELAB and the docker-compose examples — many folks copy the compose file.
Priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/704 — updates snippets, adds auth_check.sh, adds docs-ci step, and includes grep artifact.
docs-bot: automated link-checker: found 2 dead links in quickstart/hello.md — fixed in branch.

Leo: hmm, 401 in CI means the placeholder token used in CI is invalid for the hosted API check. we should make the smoke script tolerant and only fail on 401 when a real token is present. switch to: if REDWOOD_API_KEY is the default placeholder (e.g., starts with sk-test) skip the live whoami check.
Priya: updated smoke script to skip live call for placeholder tokens and to validate format before skipping. pushed fix.

Sam: LGTM. merged. created follow-up issue to run a repo-wide sweep and to add a lint rule for env var names in snippets.
